create_pretraining_config: create a pretraining config for SwAV with RegNet trunk and synthetic data
create_finetuning_config: create a finetuning config with checkpoint path, FSDP, and partial head loading options
get_optimizer_param_groups: get optimizer parameter groups from a built model and finetuning configuration
